attchmntText: Shriram Properties Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Auditors of the company.
voiceSummary: Shriram Properties Limited has disclosed the resignation of statutory auditors for two material subsidiaries. M/s Walker Chandiok & Co LLP resigned as auditor of Shriprop Properties Private Limited, and M/s V G G C & Associates resigned as auditor of Global Entropolis (Vizag) Private Limited. Both resignations were submitted via letters dated November 13, 2026. The stated reason for both changes is to align the subsidiaries' auditors with the holding company, Shriram Properties Limited, due to mandatory auditor rotation requirements. The resignations are effective immediately. The auditors confirmed there are no disagreements with management or other material reasons for the departure. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Shriram Properties Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of  Mrs. Anita Kapur, Mr. K. G. Krishnamurthy and Mr. T.S. Vijayan as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: Shriram Properties Limited informs the National Stock Exchange and BSE that Mrs. Anita Kapur, Mr. Kulumani Gopalratnam Krishnamurthy, and Mr. Thai Salas Vijayan have completed their tenure as Non-Executive Independent Directors with effect from the end of the day on November 13, 2026. Consequently, they cease to be Independent Directors of the Company. The Board of Directors and Management have placed on record their appreciation for the valuable contributions and guidance provided by these directors during their association with the Company. Details required under Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations are annexed. This intimation is also hosted on the Company website at www.shriramproperties.com.

attchmntText: Shriram Properties Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Shriram Properties Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported H1 FY27 revenues of Rs. 543 Crs, an 11% year-on-year increase. Profit after tax for the half-year stood at Rs. 32.6 Crs, reflecting a 12% year-on-year growth. For the second quarter alone, revenues reached Rs. 272 Crs, up 19% year-on-year, while profit after tax rose 151% to Rs. 21.6 Crs. The firm collected Rs. 795 Crs in the first half of the fiscal year. Shriram Properties highlighted a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.5x and a CRISIL A- (Positive) rating. The company also noted the acquisition of joint ventures into subsidiaries, which adds approximately Rs. 1,800 Crs in revenue recognition potential.

attchmntText: Shriram Properties Limited has informed regarding approval of Board of Directors for Re-classification of Shriram Group Executives Welfare Trust ( SGEWT ) from the  Promoter category to the  Public  category:
voiceSummary: Shriram Properties Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a loss of 1,844 lakhs for the period, compared to a loss of 1,821 lakhs in the same period last year. Basic earnings per share stood at minus 1.08 rupees. The board also approved the allotment of 4,52,971 equity shares under the ESOP 2013 plan. Additionally, the board reconstituted various committees following changes in board composition. The board approved the reclassification of Shriram Group Executives Welfare Trust from the Promoter category to the Public category. This reclassification is subject to stock exchange approval. The company will submit an application to the exchanges for no-objection regarding this change.

attchmntText: Shriram Properties Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Strong Earnings and Growth Momentum in Q2; Stronger Outlook for H2".
voiceSummary: Shriram Properties Limited filed a press release regarding its Unaudited Financial Results for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. Total revenues for Q2 stood at Rs. 272.3 crores, up 19% year-on-year. EBITDA grew 235% to Rs. 62.4 crores, and Net Profit increased 151% to Rs. 21.6 crores. For the half-year, total revenues were Rs. 543.3 crores, with Net Profit at Rs. 32.6 crores. The company acquired partners’ interests in five joint ventures, converting them to wholly owned subsidiaries. Net debt rose to Rs. 761 crores due to JV consolidation, with a Net Debt-to-Equity ratio of 0.5x. The company expects to hand over 2,300 units in the remainder of the year.

attchmntText: Shriram Properties Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Shriram Properties Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the half-year ended September 30, 2026. The board also approved the allotment of 4,52,971 equity shares under the ESOP 2013 plan. Additionally, the board reconstituted various committees following changes in board composition. The board approved the reclassification of Shriram Group Executives Welfare Trust from the promoter category to the public category, subject to stock exchange approval. The company will submit an application to the exchanges for this reclassification. The statutory auditors issued a review report with no material misstatements noted, though they highlighted a search operation by the Enforcement Directorate in October 2024 with no further developments.

attchmntText: Shriram Properties Limited has informed regarding Announcement under Regulation 31A (LODR)-(8)(a) Receipt of request
voiceSummary: Shriram Properties Limited received a request from Shriram Group Executives Welfare Trust to reclassify its shareholding from Promoter to Public category. The trust currently holds 2,40,500 shares, representing 0.14% of the company. This request follows the divestment of the trust's entire stake in Shriram Properties Holdings Private Limited to Mr. M. Murali. The trust no longer holds indirect shares or voting rights in the company and does not exercise control. The board will consider the request, subject to stock exchange approval under Regulation 31A of the Listing Regulations.
